scope: HERO forward central only, local endpoint archive only, no reconstruction of prior study outcomes. Metadata lineage is the only initially authorized operation. No passive native TEST/validation species; no index 6, reserves, trajectories, physical samples or paid jobs.
lineage: Verify both previous trials' entire private identity rosters against their published identity hashes and source row pairs before any native features. Match exact uint64 seed AND id, including across temperatures. Only unique native TRAIN bulk seed rows. Exclude prior #04 parent metadata, tranche2 non-fit roles, all local and spatial cycle roles, all native validation/TEST, preparation streams and old reserve/issued fork cohorts, original out-of-fold preflight exams and historical R4 index9 tripod tuning. Index9 feasibility only; never reallocate temperatures or reopen historical assessments. Previous first-pass RSMI and later generic TRAIN lineage reuse is named explicitly; no claim of globally independent data.
draw: Preserve native TRAIN permutation order after exclusions, apply independent PCG64([26112401,index]).permutation per temperature; contiguous disjoint segments in registered role order. First 256/1024/4096 of fit form nested ladders with identical anchors.
anchor_seed: PCG64([26112402,index,native_row]); discovery = choice(8000,64,replace=False). Assessment = uniform integer shift independently along each of z,y,x in 0..9, then all lexicographic offsets {0,10}^3 plus that shift. Uniform over grid phases (full eight-anchor set). Issue = one uniform flat integer 0..7999. No labels/inventories consulted for allocation.
geometry: L20 periodic z,y,x, flat=400*z+20*y+x; V=lex [-1,1]^3 full ternary, E=lex maxnorm4 full ternary; E5 copies the 386 E rows and changes every ±4 coordinate to ±5. No symmetry averaging or reorientation. Check all 24 proper signed axis permutations and 24 improper isometries as site permutations, min toroidal L1 3/4 vs local term diameter 2; centers hidden from every other opportunity's shell on the 10-grid. No implication of learned-rule invariance. Archive and bank bytes are unpacked C-order uint8 species 0 vacancy,1 A,2 B. I[P,Q,2]=[Nvac,NA] uint16 of maxnorm<=3 open cube at BOTH radii. No other side features. S not stored. No hidden-issue stage ever.
artifacts: Private rosters.npz stores role_parent/seed/id/anchor. Discovery {fit,tune,rule}.npz: parent,anchor,V,E,I,E5. Boundary blind-{cold,transfer,hot,issue}.npz: parent,anchor,E,I,E5 only, no V. Hidden-{cold,transfer,hot} lower-case filenames hidden-{role}.npz: parent,anchor,V only. Public receipts pin role, roster and file content. Predictors must never open native archives or hidden banks before the signed-prediction release.
access_and_memory: Stream ascending selected native rows of compressed species.npy. Hashing compressed bytes to verify the source and forward ZIP decompression past denied rows is NOT scientific observation. Never materialize an unselected parent. Trusted boundary extraction has one transient selected row (8000 bytes) to compute global fixed [2000,2400] minus counts on the complement of its own 343-site cube. Exterior runs are counted only as histograms, including other anchors' interiors when needed; no microscopic V tensor/labels constructed. Only allowed shell positions gathered. Hidden stage exports only specified central bytes. Discovery stores ~201 MiB output for 4096*64 anchors including R5 (not duplicated per optimizer seed); no archive-scale RAM materialization. Record wall time/RSS/output size. No file overwrite or exam release by the extractor.
release: Explicit Main issuance is required per stage and role: release-{discovery|blind|hidden}-{role}.json committed in public HERO directory; stage,role,lineage_sha256 and nonempty prerequisites mapping public artifact names to sha256. CLI checks Git immutable blobs against working bytes, permitted role, time, roster hash, role identity and source. Hidden additionally checks Git-published predictions-{role}.{npz,json}, validated complete same opportunity IDs/order, finite numeric predictions, pinned blind bank/roster SHA and exact count. Issuance precedes hidden bytes. No exam release merely because extraction code exists. Inadequate capacity => stop confirmatory assessment, no substitution.
